source: Voxelholm townsfolk personas draft (EdwardAThomson/voxelholm PR #214, docs/personas.md): five personas, one manner each.

manners.plain: direct and unceremonious: no flourishes, few courtesies
manners.warm: friendly and familiar: easy with people, quick to draw them in
manners.proper: courteous and formal: careful forms of address, measured sentences

grumbler.notices: what is wrong, late, badly done or unfair, and who is to blame
grumbler.with_others: expects little of them and says so; grudging thanks

worrier.notices: risks, what could go wrong, what has not been checked
worrier.with_others: asks whether they are sure; seeks reassurance and doubts it

gossip.notices: other people: who said what, who is seeing whom, the latest news
gossip.with_others: draws them in, trades what they know for what they have heard

dreamer.notices: beauty, distance, what lies beyond, what might be one day
dreamer.with_others: gentle and a little absent; drifts from the business at hand

oldtimer.label: old-timer
oldtimer.notices: how things used to be done and what has changed since
oldtimer.with_others: courteous, unhurried, measures the present against long memory
